chunks: And Hammad narrated from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
Indeed, the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله approved the testimony of women in matters of debt while no man was with them.

key_terms.أَجَازَ: approved or validated as legally acceptable
key_terms.النِّسَاءِ: women whose testimony is under discussion
key_terms.رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, whose ruling is being reported

ai.seo_question: Can the testimony of women be accepted in debt cases without a man present?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله accepted the testimony of women in cases involving debt even when no man was present with them. It serves as a jurisprudential proof concerning evidentiary rules in financial matters.
